get.summary: Returns the look and feel of the logged in user.
get.description: This API returns the look and feel that the logged in user would see in the SSP. The response includes colour, tile size, search and welcome texts and links to the logo and search banner. If you are using a browser to access the API, the Accept-Language header (used to determine translations for the search and welcome texts) will be sent automatically, based on your browser language. If you call the API using another technology, you will need to explicitly include this header.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: The language of the user, used to determine the correct translations.

schema.description: Look and Feel of logged in user

403.description: Forbidden - typically returned if the API is called while authenticated as an operator.

get.summary: Returns the logo for the look and feel of the logged in user.
get.description: This API returns the logo, as a binary image (e.g. PNG or JPEG), for the look and feel that the logged in user would see in the SSP.

403.description: Forbidden - typically returned if the API is called while authenticated as an operator.

get.summary: Returns the search textbox background image for the look and feel of the logged in user.
get.description: This API returns the search textbox background, as a binary image (e.g. PNG or JPEG), for the look and feel that the logged in user would see in the SSP.

403.description: Forbidden - typically returned if the API is called while authenticated as an operator.

color.description: The color of the look and feel, represented as a hexadecimal value in the format #RRGGBB

useSmallTiles.description: Indicates if this look and feel uses small or large tiles

logoURL.description: A URL that points to the logo that is used in this look and feel

searchBannerURL.description: A URL that points to the search textbox background that is used in this look and feel

title.description: The translation for the title, in the first language supported by TOPdesk from those in the Accept-Language header field. If none of the languages in the header is supported, the translation in the fallback language (as configured in TOPdesk) is returned.

searchText.description: The translation for the search text, in the first language supported by TOPdesk supplied in the Accept-Language header field. If none of the languages in the header is supported, the translation in the fallback language (as configured in TOPdesk) is returned.
